teacher.sample:
fill: I ___ to school every day. = go # Present Simple with I: the verb has no ending.
choice: She ___ a teacher. * is / are / am # We use "is" with she/he/it.
listen: door # Listen to the English word and write it.
dialogue: A: Where are you? >> B: I ___ here. (am) # We use "am" with "I".
